target: modern printed Persian books and PDFs
selection: validation-only weighted font and real-document error; original control eligible
new_test: source-document holdout pseudo labels plus known-text held-out font subset; only evaluated after selection
external_development: same 100 reference pages, 13 modern subset; never used for gradient updates
limits: Worker cap 5000 seconds per trial; GPU weekly quota checked before launch
caveats: real document labels are automated and filtered
global font novelty cannot be established for corpora without font IDs
execution_optimization: Replica-local CTC and KL sums; numerical loss/gradient equivalence verified on actual CPU and two-T4 crops. No change to objectives
final_selection: Compare completed trial validation scores; persist decision before reading test metrics. Test accuracy is not used to choose trial or checkpoint.
